jobs.title: Senior SAP Logistics Project Manager in Pharma
jobs.jd_full:
We are looking for an experienced SAP Logistics Project Manager to lead SAP logistics and supply chain transformation initiatives within a complex pharmaceutical environment. The role focuses on managing SAP implementation, integration, and optimisation projects across warehouse management, inventory management, procurement, and distribution processes.

You will be responsible for end-to-end project delivery, coordinating cross-functional teams, managing stakeholders, and ensuring SAP logistics solutions align with business requirements, operational objectives, and pharmaceutical regulatory standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end SAP logistics projects, including implementation, migration, integration, and optimisation initiatives.
  • Manage project scope, timelines, budgets, resources, risks, and deliverables to ensure successful execution.
  • Oversee SAP logistics workstreams involving SAP EWM, MM, WM, and related supply chain processes.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams, including SAP functional consultants, technical specialists, business stakeholders, and external vendors.
  • Ensure alignment between SAP solutions and business requirements across warehouse management, procurement, inventory management, and distribution.
  • Manage integration dependencies between SAP logistics modules and other enterprise systems.
  • Lead project governance activities, including stakeholder reporting, risk management, and escalation processes.
  • Oversee testing, data migration, deployment, and go-live readiness activities.
  • Ensure project delivery complies with pharmaceutical industry regulations, including GxP and GDP requirements.
  • Support change management, business process improvements, and user adoption during SAP transformations.
  • Minimum 8 years of experience in IT or SAP project management, with a strong focus on logistics and supply chain projects.
  • Proven experience managing end-to-end SAP logistics implementations, rollouts, or transformation projects.
  • Strong understanding of SAP logistics modules, particularly SAP EWM, MM, WM, and their integration with other SAP solutions.
  • Experience managing SAP S/4HANA and/or SAP ECC projects.
  • Solid understanding of warehouse management, inventory management, procurement, and distribution processes.
  • Experience working within pharmaceutical or other regulated environments, with knowledge of GxP and GDP requirements.
  • Strong project management capabilities, including budget management, resource planning, risk mitigation, and vendor coordination.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams and managing senior business and IT stakeholders.
  • Knowledge of project management methodologies, including Waterfall, Agile, and hybrid approaches.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills.
  • Fluent English is required.

    Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with SAP S/4HANA logistics transformation programs.
  • Familiarity with SAP SD, PP, QM, or TM and their integration with logistics processes.
  • Experience with warehouse automation, supply chain integration, or distribution systems.

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager, Compliance Ops
jobs.jd_full:
Become a part of our caring community

The Lead Product Manager, Compliance Operations, owns the operational management of Humana’s FHIR APIs and healthcare interoperability products. This role is accountable for day-to-day API operations, end-to-end partner onboarding, production support, operational performance, and continuous operational improvement.

The role serves as the primary business owner for the operational experience of providers, payers, third-party applications, and other approved partners using Humana’s interoperability APIs, coordinating closely with IT and other stakeholder teams to maintain reliable, scalable, and effective API operations.

The Lead Product Manager, Compliance Operations, leads the ongoing operations of Humana’s healthcare interoperability and FHIR API products. This role owns the operational lifecycle of the APIs, including day-to-day operations, partner onboarding, production support, issue and escalation management, operational performance, and continuous improvement.


The Lead Product Manager owns the end-to-end onboarding experience for providers, payers, third-party applications, and other approved partners, from initial request through access and connectivity, testing, production enablement, and transition to ongoing support.


Following onboarding, this role owns the support model for the FHIR APIs, coordinating with IT and other stakeholder teams to triage and resolve production issues, manage escalations, communicate with partners, and identify recurring operational concerns.


The role also owns continuous operational improvement of the FHIR API ecosystem. Operational trends, onboarding friction, recurring support issues, incidents, and opportunities for automation or process improvement are translated into operational enhancements and prioritized into the product backlog. Business and strategic product enhancements remain outside the scope of this role.


Regulatory Compliance retains primary ownership for regulatory interpretation and compliance oversight. The Lead Product Manager supports Regulatory Compliance by maintaining operational information and providing API, onboarding, support, and performance data as requested.


This role exercises independent judgment and decision-making on complex operational issues and works under minimal supervision to coordinate business, product, technology, operational, and external stakeholders


Key Responsibilities


FHIR API Operations

  • Own the day-to-day operations of Humana’s FHIR APIs and interoperability products, including Patient Access, Provider Access, Payer-to-Payer, Prior Authorization, Provider Directory, and related capabilities.
  • Monitor API operational performance, production issues, support trends, incidents, dependencies, and operational risks.
  • Coordinate with IT stakeholder teams to investigate and resolve API incidents, service issues, defects, and other production concerns.
  • Establish clear operational ownership, escalation paths, procedures, and handoffs across Product, IT, Architecture, Security, Identity and Access Management, and other supporting teams.
  • Communicate API operational health, significant incidents, risks, dependencies, and remediation status to leadership and stakeholders.

Onboarding

  • Own the end-to-end onboarding experience for providers, payers, third-party applications, and other approved partners requesting access to Humana’s interoperability APIs.
  • Manage onboarding from initial request through registration, access and authentication coordination, connectivity, testing, production enablement, and transition into ongoing support.
  • Coordinate onboarding activities and dependencies across the business, IT, security, identity, architecture, and other stakeholder teams.
  • Develop and maintain standardized onboarding processes, supporting documentation, intake procedures, partner communications, and escalation paths.
  • Monitor onboarding performance and identify opportunities to reduce delays, simplify processes, improve partner experience, and increase operational scalability.

Production Support

  • Own the post-onboarding support model for Humana’s FHIR APIs and external interoperability partners.
  • Establish processes for partner questions, support requests, production issues, incident escalation, issue triage, and ongoing partner communications.
  • Coordinate with IT stakeholder teams responsible for technical investigation and resolution while maintaining ownership of the overall support experience.
  • Ensure issues have clear ownership, appropriate prioritization, documented resolution paths, and effective communication with impacted stakeholders.
  • Identify recurring support issues and trends requiring operational remediation.

Continuous Operational Improvement

  • Own the continuous operational improvement of Humana’s FHIR API ecosystem.
  • Analyze incidents, support trends, onboarding friction, operational metrics, recurring issues, and partner feedback to identify improvement opportunities.
  • Identify opportunities for process simplification, automation, improved monitoring, enhanced documentation, and more scalable operational support.
  • Translate identified operational needs into operational enhancements and backlog items and work with Product Owners and delivery teams to prioritize and implement them.
  • Ensure enhancements owned by this role remain focused on operational effectiveness, supportability, reliability, onboarding, and production operations, rather than new business capabilities or strategic product enhancements.

Compliance Support & Reporting

  • Partner with Regulatory Compliance while maintaining a clear separation between operational ownership and regulatory compliance ownership.
  • Provide Regulatory Compliance with API operational, onboarding, support, performance, and other relevant data as requested.
  • Maintain appropriate operational documentation and records to support compliance inquiries, assessments, and audit-readiness activities.
  • Define and maintain operational reporting and metrics covering areas such as API operations, onboarding, support demand, issue resolution, service performance, and operational improvements.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Drive collaboration across Product, Product Owners, IT, Architecture, Security, Identity and Access Management, Regulatory Compliance, Operations, and other stakeholder teams.
  • Serve as a central point of operational coordination for FHIR API-related onboarding, production support, and operational issues.
  • Communicate operational performance, risks, trends, and improvement opportunities to senior leadership.
  • Maintain current operational procedures, onboarding materials, support documentation, requirements, and business artifacts.
  • Mentor Product Managers and Product Owners on FHIR API operations, partner onboarding, production support, and operational product management practices.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Operations, Healthcare Technology, Technical Operations, Business Analysis, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience leading cross-functional initiatives involving business and technology teams.
  • Experience owning or supporting production APIs, integration platforms, technology products, or healthcare data exchange capabilities.
  • Experience with partner onboarding, implementation, production operations, or technical support.
  • Experience coordinating production issues and escalations across business and technology teams.
  • Experience working within healthcare payer, provider, healthcare technology, or interoperability environments.
  • Knowledge of healthcare interoperability technologies and standards, including APIs, FHIR, HL7, OAuth, or related healthcare data exchange technologies.
  • Experience developing and managing operational processes, support models, procedures, documentation, and performance metrics.
  • Experience translating operational needs and production findings into prioritized backlog items.
  • Strong stakeholder management, communication, facilitation, and presentation skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and influence cross-functional teams without direct authority.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess operational, business, technical, and compliance impacts.
  • Experience working in Agile environments and collaborating with Product Owners and technology delivery teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Public Health, Information Systems, or related field.
  • SAFe Agile, Product Management, ITIL, or related product/operations certification.
  • Experience operating FHIR APIs in a production healthcare environment.
  • Experience supporting CMS interoperability capabilities, including Patient Access, Provider Access, Payer-to-Payer, Prior Authorization, and Provider Directory APIs.
  • Experience managing provider, payer, or third-party application API onboarding and production support.
  • Experience with API registration, authentication, authorization, identity and access management, and partner connectivity processes.
  • Knowledge of production support disciplines, including incident management, problem management, root-cause analysis, escalation management, monitoring, and service performance.
  • Experience using operational data and support trends to drive continuous improvement and backlog prioritization.
  • Experience defining or managing operational KPIs, SLAs, onboarding metrics, and support performance metrics.
  • Familiarity with healthcare integration technologies, HIT, EDI, API gateways, and API management platforms.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps and Agile product management practices.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager, Customer Experience
jobs.jd_full:
Are you an expert in orchestrating high-impact software implementations from kickoff to go-live? Do you enjoy translating complex enterprise requirements into seamless delivery plans? Are you eager to make your mark in an industry ready for disruption, helping investment managers reimagine their operations with innovative cloud technology? If so, we invite you to be a part of our innovative team.

As a Customer Experience Senior Project Manager at Ridgeline, you will be responsible for leading end-to-end implementations of the Ridgeline enterprise cloud software for investment management customers. You will directly interact with both internal and customer stakeholders to define and deliver an agreed upon scope of services in a project management capacity. Gravitas and exceptional organizational skills are paramount. A consultative approach, innovative mindset, and collaborative spirit will also be key as you continue your track record of successful go-lives and make a meaningful impact on an industry primed for change.

At Ridgeline, how we work matters as much as what we build. Ridgeliners act like owners, choose growth over comfort, and communicate with transparency. We assume positive intent, bias toward action, and bring solutions—not just problems. We celebrate wins, learn from setbacks, and thrivein a resilient, collaborative, high-performing culture. If this excites you, we’d love to meet you.

You must be work authorized in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship.

What You’ll Do?

  • Project Planning and Design: Define project goals, plan scope, allocate resources, and set timelines.
  • Team Leadership: Lead and motivate the project team, assign tasks, and ensure collaboration.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary point of contact for stakeholders, ensuring clear communication and managing expectations.
  • Budget Management: Oversee the project budget, ensuring cost-effectiveness and financial tracking.
  • Quality Control: Ensure project deliverables meet quality standards and stakeholder requirements.
  • Risk Management: Identify potential project risks, devise mitigation strategies, and manage any issues that arise.
  • Project Evaluation: Assess project outcomes against objectives, analyze performance, and report on results to stakeholders.
  • Hands-On Task Execution: Directly engage in and complete critical project tasks as necessary to support team efforts and project success.
  • Domestic travel 25-50%

Desired Skills and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field of study
  • 5+ years of experience leading investment management software implementations in a customer-facing role
  • Investment management industry knowledge of front office and back office systems, workflows and processes (ex. portfolio accounting, performance measurement, trading, reconciliation, data, compliance, reporting, etc.)
  • Skilled Project Management practitioner with a proven track record; adept at coordinating functional and technical resources
  • Ability to work independently, with general direction and guidance; highly organized with excellent time management skills and the ability to manage competing priorities with a hands-on approach
  • Innate curiosity and proven ability to learn new software technologies quickly
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with an ability to build relationships with internal and external customer stakeholders, including senior leadership

Bonus:

  • Understanding of Agile principles and software development lifecycles
  • Familiarity with Google Apps and/or the MS Office suite
  • Comfortable leveraging tools such as Slack, JIRA/Confluence, and Mavenlink for project management and communication
  • Basic understanding of AWS, APIs, and serverless technology
  • Project Management certifications such as PMP, CAPM, PRINCE2 a plus

About Ridgeline

Ridgeline is the first front-to-back system of record for investment managers. Founded by visionary entrepreneur Dave Duffield (co-founder of both PeopleSoft and Workday), the company was created to modernize an industry held back by outdated, disconnected technology. Powered by a single, real-time data set and embedded AI, Ridgeline helps firms automate complexity, accelerate collaboration, and deliver tailored client experiences at scale, without added headcount or risk. Ridgeline is headquartered in Lake Tahoe, with offices in New York, Reno, and the Bay Area, and is recognized by Fast Company as a “Best Workplace for Innovators,” by Frost & Sullivan as a “Technology Innovation Leader,” and by The Software Report as a “Top 100 Software Company.”

Ridgeline is proud to be a community-minded, discrimination-free equal opportunity workplace.

Ridgeline processes the information you submit in connection with your application in accordance with the Ridgeline Applicant Privacy Statement. Please review the Ridgeline Applicant Privacy Statement in full to understand our privacy practices and contact us with any questions.

We also offer rich benefits that reflect the kind of organization we want to be: one in which our employees feel valued and are inspired to bring their best selves to work. jobs.title: Senior Data Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
Senior Data Product Manager

AcuityMD is the AI platform for MedTech trusted by over 500 MedTech companies – including 16 of the top 20. Commercial leaders use AcuityMD to identify target markets, surface top opportunities, and grow their business. By combining real-world healthcare data with AI-powered insights, AcuityMD enables companies from pre-commercial to enterprise to understand where and how to sell faster to accelerate the adoption of medical technology. AcuityMD ranked No. 316 on the 2026 Inc. 5000 list of the fastest-growing private companies in America and was named to Forbes’ 2025 “Next Billion-Dollar Startups” list – an elite group of 25 venture-backed U.S. companies identified as most likely to reach a $1 billion valuation.‍ AcuityMD is backed by Stepstone Group, Benchmark, Redpoint Ventures, ICONIQ, and Atreides Management.

As a Senior Data Product Manager, you will build and refine AcuityMD’s data assets, products, model and platform. You’ll play a critical role in identifying market opportunities, crafting compelling product offerings, and bringing agentic AI solutions to life. You will build empathy for our users, solve complex problems and drive business success for our customers and for AcuityMD. You will work cross-functionally with engineering and customer-facing teams.

Team Mission

We are building a world-class data products team to meticulously craft and deliver data assets and algorithms that enable new workflows and power AcuityAI to solve customer problems. Our team is the critical link between what our engineers build and what our customers need. We are looking for product leaders to develop deep empathy for our users, apply data and AI to prioritize user needs, and bring new capabilities to life by aligning and coordinating across technical and customer-facing teams.

Responsibilities

  • Own a product area end-to-end: deeply understand customer problems, define the product vision, clearly articulate desired outcomes and acceptance criteria, prioritize ruthlessly, and ship thoughtfully.
  • Prototype, test and deliver new data products and algorithms with engineering and small, nimble cross-functional teams
  • Drive discovery by partnering with customers, product marketing, and data teams to uncover unmet needs and turn them into compelling, scalable software
  • Integrate AI effectively, both in how you work (e.g., research, analysis, content generation) and in what we build, leveraging LLMs and automation where they create user value and differentiation.
  • Collaborate with data, machine learning, and analytics engineers to operationalize and harden our data products and tooling, and to ensure the success of solutions that build on our data
  • Communicate clearly and regularly - both in meetings and in writing. You’ll drive a compelling roadmap to ensure everyone is working toward clear goals and outcomes.
  • Balance short- and long-term bets. Keep the team focused on measurable outcomes today while building toward a compelling long-term product vision.
  • Own key metrics to measure and improve product and business outcomes
  • Uphold high standards of integrity, curiosity, and ambition—championing what’s right for our users, our team, and the business.

Your Profile

  • Motivated by building exceptional products and building a winning AI company.
  • 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in vertical B2B. You’ll have a successful record of managing and shipping great software products.
  • 1+ years leading and building AI solutions.
  • You have built complex data products as part of a cross-functional team.
  • You have practical hands-on technical experience and use it extensively. You’re not afraid to get your hands dirty digging into data, building code with AI tools and tracking metrics.
  • Strong grasp of product fundamentals: discovery, prioritization, metrics, user feedback loops, and go-to-market alignment. You know what good product management looks like.
  • Adept at using AI tools in your daily work and experience delivering AI powered features. You have a realistic understanding of LLM capabilities and limits.
  • Proven ability to make smart tradeoffs in ambiguous environments—handling technical constraints, business priorities and strong personalities.
  • You pay strong attention to detail and you write things down. You communicate clearly and concisely, and tell stories using data.
  • You are curious and seek to understand, question, and improve our products. You build empathy for customer problems and have a bias towards action to solve them.
  • You seek hard problems to solve and are comfortable with ambiguity. You drive prioritization and make tradeoff decisions

Nice to Haves

  • You have built healthcare-specific data products as part of a cross-functional team
  • Prior product management experience in vertical growth stage AI solutions
  • Experience with LLM integration, data-driven solutions, or complex user roles/personas.
  • Ability to build prototypes with tools like Claude Code
  • Deep desire to understand and empathize with a dataset before using it
  • Demonstrated mentorship or leadership in previous PM roles

AcuityMD is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, market data and may vary from the range provided. Base salary range: $175,000-$215,000

You must have an eligible work permit in the USA to be considered for this position

We Offer:

  • Ground floor opportunity: Join a high-growth startup, backed by world-class investors across Enterprise SaaS and Medical Devices (Benchmark, Redpoint Ventures, and Ajax Health).
  • Learning Budget: Reimbursements for relevant learning and up-skilling opportunities.
  • Remote work: AcuityMD is committed to supporting full-remote flexibility for employees in the US. We provide a work-from-home stipend for all employees.
  • Flexible PTO: Generous time off and flexible hours give you the freedom to do your best work.
  • Paid Health, Dental, and Vision Plans: We offer 100% paid health, dental, and vision plans for all employees and 75% paid for our employees’ dependents.
  • Home Office Stipend: $1,000 to invest in remote office equipment and WiFi reimbursement.
  • Optional Team Retreats: We meet in-person multiple times per year for co-working and social gatherings.
  • Parental Leave: 8-16 weeks of fully-paid, flexible parental leave.

Who We Are:

The Company: We are builders, who are inspired by our mission to expand patient access to cutting-edge medical technologies. We value working collaboratively to solve hard problems for our customers with simple, innovative solutions. We push ourselves to learn with empathy. We foster an active culture of mentorship and inclusion, and we welcome new team members that share our values.

We’re backed by Benchmark, Redpoint Ventures, Ajax Health, ICONIQ Growth and several other leading software and medical device investors. Since Acuity launched in 2020, we’ve brought on customers ranging from publicly traded Fortune 500 companies to innovative growth-stage companies and regional medical device distributors.

The Product: AcuityMD uses data and software to help teams collaborate around the complex relationships they have with the users of medical technologies: doctors. Our platform empowers medical technology companies to see how their products are used, understand why outcomes vary, and identify opportunities where physicians or sites of care can better serve their patients.

How We Work:

AcuityMD is a remote-first company. We believe the best talent isn’t confined to one zip code, so our team works from wherever they do their best work, across the U.S.

We also believe some of our best work happens face-to-face. Critical projects move faster, our products get better, and our community gets stronger when we’re in the same room, so we bring the team together throughout the year for company-wide and team on-sites built around that work.

In practice: expect 4-5 in-person opportunities a year through company/team on-sites and in-person collaboration for critical projects. If you’re based near our Boston hub, there’s no set requirement for how often you come into the office, that’s your call, based on what works best for you and your team.

AcuityMD is an Equal Opportunity Employer

AcuityMD is seeking to create a diverse work environment because all teams are stronger with different perspectives and life experiences. We strongly encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, religion, color, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. All employees and contractors of AcuityMD are responsible for maintaining a work culture free from discrimination and harassment by treating others with kindness and respect.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.jd_full:
At WelbeHealth, we serve our communities’ most vulnerable seniors through shared intention, pioneering spirit, and the courage to love. These core values and our participant focus lead the way no matter what.

Under the direction of the Director, Analytics Translation, the Technical Product Manager is accountable for leading and building best-in-class data solutions, ensuring that our healthcare products and services align with our strategic objectives. This role collaborates closely with cross-functional teams, including healthcare professionals, software engineers, data engineers, and business stakeholders, to create and manage a portfolio of healthcare products that meet the needs of our provider and payer operations.

This role is different because the Technical Product Manager at WelbeHealth:

  • Translates complex healthcare and business needs into innovative, scalable technology products by developing product roadmaps, defining technical requirements, and prioritizing features that improve provider and payer operations
  • Bridges the gap between business stakeholders and technical teams, driving product development from concept through delivery while balancing user needs, technical feasibility, regulatory requirements, and measurable business outcomes

We care about our team members. That’s why we offer:

  • Medical insurance coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision)
  • Work/life balance - We mean it! 17 days of personal time off (PTO), 12 holidays observed annually, and 6 sick days
  • 401K savings + match
  • Comprehensive compensation package including base pay and bonus
  • And additional benefits!

On the day-to-day, you will:

  • Own, prioritize, and maintain the Product Backlog, including definition of user stories and acceptance criteria, and assess impact of defects including providing key input on decisions
  • Manage communications to ensure stakeholders are informed of development ROI, investment planning, changes, and execution progress across the program
  • Work closely with engineering, solution architecture, domain SMEs, and healthcare professionals to drive product development, ensuring timely delivery of high-impact solutions
  • Participate in scrum ceremonies to facilitate efficient product development cycles, including facilitating solution design and backlog grooming sessions, and participating in daily scrum, sprint planning, and iteration reviews
  • Champion user-centric design principles, collaborating with design teams to ensure the development of intuitive, user-friendly healthcare products
  • Work with stakeholders to identify users that will complete User Acceptance Testing (UAT), design a plan with customers, and facilitate the execution of that review and acceptance testing
  • Monitor product performance using relevant metrics and data analysis, identifying opportunities for optimization and continuous improvement

Job requirements include:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field; professional experience may be substituted
  • Minimum of five (5) years of product management experience
  • Minimum of three (3) years of decomposing business requirements into features and user stories, and writing technical documentation to support solution delivery
  • Minimum of two (2) years of experience working with Agile methodologies, leading product teams, and managing end-to-end product development processes and product lifecycle
  • Experience within the healthcare industry (provider or payer settings) highly desired with a demonstrated ability to discover opportunities and deliver products
  • Proven track record in product management, preferably in technology/software within the healthcare industry
  • Track record of reliably managing complex processes to on-time completion
  • Demonstrated ability to build trust-based relationships with a diverse group of stakeholders

We’re seeking a strategic Technical Product Manager who is passionate about developing innovative healthcare technology solutions, connecting business needs with technical capabilities, and delivering products that make a meaningful impact. If you’re ready to contribute to a mission-driven organization while helping shape the future of healthcare, we’d love to hear from you!

Compensation consists of base salary plus bonus. WelbeHealth offers a competitive total rewards package that includes a 401(k) match, comprehensive healthcare coverage, and a broad range of additional benefits. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience and relevant qualifications.

Compensation Offering

$132,181.05—$174,478.99 USD

COVID-19 Vaccination Policy

At WelbeHealth, our mission is to unlock the full potential of our vulnerable seniors. In this spirit, please note that we have a vaccination policy for all our employees and proof of vaccination, or a vaccine declination form will be required prior to employment. jobs.title: Program Manager, Digital Customer Success
jobs.jd_full:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust.We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it.

Vanta is looking for a Program Manager to build and scale digital-first customer experiences that accelerate onboarding, product activation, and ongoing adoption. You’ll turn customer insights, product usage data, automation, and AI into programs that help early-stage and mid-market customers realize value and support retention and growth.

The team

The Digital Success Programs team creates scalable, personalized customer experiences that extend the reach of Customer Success. The team partners across Customer Success, Product, Marketing, Education, Community, Data, and Operations to deliver measurable customer outcomes through digital engagement, education, automation, and community programs.

The role

As a Program Manager on the Digital Success Programs team, you’ll own programs across the customer lifecycle and help translate product priorities and customer needs into repeatable, measurable engagement. It is a builder role for someone who can combine program management, customer empathy, data fluency, with strong cross-functional execution.

What you’ll do as a Program Manager at Vanta

  • Own one or more digital customer success programs end to end, such as cohort onboarding and one-to-many activation programs that integrate education and community engagement.

  • Design, build, and optimize scalable email communications across onboarding, activation, and adoption stages, using customer attributes, product usage signals, and behavioral triggers.

  • Partner with Customer Success, Product, Education, Marketing, and Community to tailor programs to customer segments, adoption milestones, and risk signals.

  • Measure program performance against onboarding, activation, engagement, and time-to-value goals, and continuously improve program outcomes.

  • Partner on activation strategy and own digital program execution for product launches and strategic adoption initiatives.

  • Build activation experiences across email, in-app messaging, educational resources, community programming, and live learning.

  • Identify opportunities for proactive intervention and deeper adoption using customer and product data.

  • Define program-level success metrics and partner with Data on reporting that connects digital engagement to activation, adoption, and retention.

  • Use AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT to streamline workflows, develop content, analyze insights, and improve program efficiency.

  • Build frontline awareness, buy-in, and enablement so partners can successfully adopt and support new programs.

How to be successful in this role

  • 5+ years of experience in customer-facing, lifecycle marketing, customer success, or program management roles, preferably in SaaS.

  • Experience designing, launching, and optimizing scalable onboarding, product activation, and customer engagement programs, ideally within a digital-first or scaled Customer Success model.

  • Strong understanding of the customer journey, product adoption, and retention levers, with experience using behavioral triggers and customer data to deliver targeted, personalized engagements.

  • Ability to analyze product usage and engagement data, measure program effectiveness, and continuously optimize for impact.

  • Strong project management skills, with a structured approach to defining goals, scope, milestones, and success metrics while independently driving cross-functional initiatives.

  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and customer-facing content development skills.

  • Proficiency with AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT to improve workflows, accelerate execution, and drive operational efficiency.

  • Experience with Salesforce, Snowflake, Customer.io, customer success platforms, or similar systems.

  • Exposure to customer education, community engagement, or content strategy.

  • Uses AI in day-to-day work to amplify their skills and strengthen their outcomes, applying it across routine workflows, actively building fluency through experimentation, and exercising sound judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets a high quality bar.

Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for current or future employer sponsorship.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

  • Industry-competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% of employee-only benefit premiums covered for most medical plans

  • 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents

  • Health & wellness stipend

  • Remote workspace, internet, and cellphone stipend

  • Commuter benefits for team members who report to the SF and NYC office

  • Family planning benefits

  • Matching 401(k) contribution with immediate vesting

  • Flexible PTO policy, plus 80 hours of Sick Time

  • 11 company-paid holidays

  • Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

  • Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar-stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors and may vary based on candidate location, skills, depth of work experience, and relevant licenses/credentials.

#LI-remote

At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.

About Vanta

We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world’s leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged.

Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that’s real-time and transparent.

jobs.title: Project Manager - COL
jobs.jd_full:
Company Description

At Sana Commerce, we’re committed to creating an inclusive environment because we know our diverse workforce is one of our greatest strengths.

It all started in 2007, with a pizza and a plan. Sana Commerce is an e-commerce platform designed to help manufacturers, distributors, and wholesalers succeed by fostering lasting relationships with customers who depend on them. We’re a fast-growing SaaS company that allows you to take ownership of your career.

At Sana Commerce, we’re looking for a Project Manager to lead the delivery of B2B e-commerce projects integrated with ERP systems. In this role, you’ll work closely with customers and cross-functional teams to ensure successful project delivery while balancing timelines, budgets, and scope.

You’ll be part of a global team, collaborating with colleagues across different regions and supporting customers primarily in North America.

Who we are:

So, what does it mean to be part of the Sana Commerce team?

  • Champions of our league: We deliver lasting success, balancing quick wins and long-term value.

  • Supercharge our customers: We’re revolutionizing B2B commerce together, helping our customers to lead and succeed.

  • Determined to Grow: We embrace challenges, growing and raising the bar for ourselves and our industry.

  • Bold Together: We dare to be bold because we have each other’s back.

Job Description

What you’ll be doing:

Project Planning & Delivery:

  • Managing multiple B2B e-commerce implementation projects simultaneously, balancing priorities across SaaS and customized solutions.

  • Planning, coordinating, and monitoring project activities to ensure successful delivery within agreed timelines, budgets, and scope.

  • Identifying potential risks, dependencies, and challenges early, taking proactive steps to address them.

  • Managing project budgets, tracking costs, and forecasting resources to maintain project profitability.

  • Ensuring project changes are properly assessed, communicated, and documented to maintain alignment with agreed deliverables.

  • Collaborating with technical and cross-functional teams to coordinate activities, resolve challenges, and keep projects moving forward.

Customer & Stakeholder Management:

  • Acting as the main point of contact for customers throughout the project lifecycle, building strong relationships and maintaining clear communication.

  • Leading customer meetings, providing project updates, and guiding discussions around progress, challenges, and next steps.

  • Proactively managing customer expectations, including navigating challenging conversations around timelines, budgets, and scope.

  • Working closely with internal stakeholders, customers, and ERP partners to ensure alignment and successful project outcomes.

  • Maintaining accurate project documentation, status reports, and communications to provide transparency to all stakeholders.

Qualifications

What you’ll bring:

  • At least 2 years of experience in project management, preferably within software delivery, SaaS, or technology-related environments.

  • Demonstrated experience working directly with external customers, confidently leading meetings, communicating progress, and managing expectations.

  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple projects and stakeholders simultaneously.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English (B2 or higher), with the confidence to navigate spontaneous conversations and challenging customer situations.

  • Ability to work 3 days per week from office in Envigado.

  • A proactive, solution-oriented mindset with the ability to identify risks, take ownership, and adapt to changing priorities.

  • Good understanding of software development processes and the ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams.

  • Experience with project budgeting, forecasting, and scope management.

  • A bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.

Nice to have:

  • Experience managing software implementation projects or working with ERP-integrated solutions.

  • Familiarity with B2B e-commerce or SaaS platforms.

  • Project management certifications such as PRINCE2, CAPM, PMP, or equivalent.

Additional Information

Additional Information

This position follows a hybrid working model, with three days per week in our Medellín office. You’ll collaborate with international colleagues and customers, so flexibility in working hours may occasionally be needed.

Job descriptions can be tough to interpret. Even if you don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you. Tell us why you believe you’d be a great match for this opportunity.
